content.text: {"abstained": false, "abstention_reason": "", "answer": "The source provides comprehensive details about the NPS Vatsalya Scheme, including: (1) Overview - it is a contributory saving and long-term financial security scheme for minors under 18 years, including NRIs and OCIs [E03]; (2) Account operation - opened by parent/guardian in the minor's name with a unique PRAN issued to the minor [E03]; (3) Opening procedure - can be opened through registered Points of Presence (POPs), eNPS platform, or other PFRDA-approved electronic modes [E03]; (4) KYC requirements - proof of date of birth for minor (birth certificate, school leaving certificate, passport, or PAN) and guardian KYC documents [E01, E03]; (5) Contributions - minimum ₹250 per annum with no maximum limit, available through physical or online modes including UPI apps [E01, E02]; (6) Account choices - selection of CRA and Pension Fund required at opening [E02]; (7) Partial withdrawals - up to 25% of contributions (excluding returns) allowed after 3 years for education, medical treatment, or disability over 75%, with up to 2 withdrawals before age 18 and 2 additional withdrawals between 18-21 years [E02]; (8) Exit options - allowed only at age 18, with up to 80% withdrawal as lump sum and balance for annuity purchase [E02]; (9) Benefits - power of compounding, financial discipline, tax efficiency, market-linked returns, and transparency [E03].", "cited_evidence_ids": ["E01", "E02", "E03"], "claim_to_evidence": [{"claim": "NPS Vatsalya is a contributory saving cum long-term financial security scheme for minors under 18 years, including NRIs and OCIs", "evidence_ids": ["E03"]}, {"claim": "Account is opened by parent/guardian in minor's name with unique PRAN issued to minor", "evidence_ids": ["E03"]}, {"claim": "Can be opened through registered POPs, eNPS platform, or other PFRDA-approved electronic modes", "evidence_ids": ["E03"]}, {"claim": "Minimum contribution is ₹250 per annum with no maximum limit", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "Contributions available through physical mode or online modes including UPI apps", "evidence_ids": ["E01", "E02"]}, {"claim": "Partial withdrawals up to 25% allowed after 3 years for education, medical treatment, or disability over 75%", "evidence_ids": ["E02"]}, {"claim": "Exit allowed only at age 18 with up to 80% withdrawal as lump sum", "evidence_ids": ["E02"]}]}
